text_block_list.text:
Ah... P-please excuse me for yawning in
the
middle of training.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I went to bed at a proper time last night,
but I
had a bit of a bad dream.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Well, it involved Голд Шипп shoving me
into a
rocket...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I'm sorry, I can't bear to say any
more. The
mere thought of it is giving
me the shivers.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I feel so disheartened. Was my day off yesterday a waste?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
